concerns.text: Task T046 mandates a 'Fail-Loudly' policy raising exceptions on fetch errors, which contradicts Spec Edge Case logic requiring the system to 'log these as insufficient data and exclude them... without halting execution' to ensure pipeline completion on partial data. This is a semantic weakening of the FR-003/Edge Case requirement.

Task T022 excludes paywalled entries from quantitative analysis. While the Plan pivots to OA-only, the Spec FR-002 requires filtering for 'non-null publication links OR task IDs' regardless of access status. The task silently narrows the corpus scope defined in the spec without an explicit 'staged simplification' marker in the task description, violating the requirement to measure the full filtered set.

Tasks T031 and T035 implement 'Observed Power' calculations and report generation. The Plan explicitly pivots to MDES as the primary metric, deeming Observed Power a 'methodological fallacy'. Implementing Observed Power as a primary deliverable without explicit deprecation or isolation as a legacy/benchmark-only feature violates the Plan's constitutional pivot and risks propagating scientifically flawed metrics.

Task T047 introduces 'Streaming/Chunked Processing' for text files >5MB. The Spec Assumptions state the dataset will fit within standard disk limits and imply standard processing. This task introduces a complexity not mandated by the spec or plan, potentially violating the 'no silent constitution drift' principle by adding unverified engineering scope.
